body:
One day bored at the house with nothing to do, I decided to see what would happen if I tried smoking a coffee bean. So, I got the lighter, the pop can, and the bean ready. It was an uplifting experience, sort of like the stimulant part of marijuana. The 'high' (I guess you could call it) lasts only 10-15 minutes, but it's a nice one at that. Music seems to go by slower by about 5 bpm, although it's easy to forget. One shouldn't expect much out of it, it's just a coffee bean, after all. Like I said before, it's like taking a toke or 3 off of a bong.
